residual_probe_gate.architecture: one-layer linear ResidualClassifier matching the frozen V9 residual-head design
residual_probe_gate.threshold_definition: chance plus two binomial standard errors; accuracy, Macro-F1, and CE gates must all pass

diagnostic_weights.default_policy: middle point of each already frozen three-point grid

protocol.benefit_sign: classification_ce benefit > 0 means candidate reduced panel CE more than ERM
protocol.counterfactual_update_mode: matched one-step AdamW branches restored from identical model and optimizer state
protocol.gradient_diagnostic_mode: base model eval mode; backbone parameters excluding supervised task head
protocol.mechanism_evaluation_probe: fixed competent detached probe shared by all branches
protocol.residual_branch: formal two-step residual-head update followed by frozen-head backbone confusion update

scientific_role.formal_claim_boundary: only the preregistered Validation tuning and multi-seed formal comparison can establish method gain
scientific_role.purpose: screen whether JS or Residual has a locally favorable optimization direction before formal Validation tuning
